parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Define electric potential at a point.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
An isolated solid metal sphere of radius $r$ is given a positive charge.

The potential at the surface of the sphere is $9.0 \times 10^4 \text{V}$. At a distance of $3r$ from the centre of the sphere, the electric field strength is $2.0 \times 10^5 \text{N C}^{-1}$.
parts.text: Determine the electric field strength at the surface of the sphere.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Show that the radius of the sphere is $5.0 \text{cm}$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Calculate the charge on the sphere.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Use your answer in (b)(iii) to determine the capacitance of the sphere.
